detailed_description: Excel to CSV converter transforms Excel spreadsheets into CSV (Comma-Separated Values) format. Supports both .xlsx and .xls files. Select specific sheets to convert and preview data before downloading.
usage_steps: Open the Excel to CSV tool page
Drag and drop an Excel file or click to select
Select the sheet to convert if multiple sheets exist
Copy or download the CSV file
usage_examples: Convert Excel data for database import
Create CSV files for data analysis tools
Export spreadsheet data in universal format
